name: MavenImport
description: Rehydrates Lucee's local maven cache from a pom.xml, resolving each listed dependency — the inverse of mavenExport for reproducible deploys.

params.name: pomPath
params.description: Filesystem path to a pom.xml file to import.

params.name: includeTransitive
params.description: If false (default), only the literal `<dependency>` entries in the pom are resolved. If true, the full transitive dependency tree is resolved for each entry.
